title: AscendEX documents USDT and USDC staking
description: AscendEX announced USDT and USDC staking with daily rewards, regular and instant unbinding, and support for using the staked assets as margin collateral.
notes: This establishes reviewed centralized staking operation by August 2021 but is not treated as the original umbrella AscendEX Earn launch date.

title: AscendEX launches REUR Fixed Earn
description: AscendEX announced six- and twelve-month REUR Fixed Earn products with published APRs and fixed-term reward mechanics.
notes: This confirms continuing Fixed Earn operation in 2026 and represents a specific product launch, not the original umbrella Earn launch date.
